administrative_boundary: Explicit coordinator evidence only; canonical acceptance and independent scientific review are not claimed for these files.

native_summary.tool_count_boundary: Generic classification ignores manual acceptance and can include separately exported reviewed tools. This is not a missing-GitHub count.

baseline_verification.boundary: Exact frozen export hashes, type-sensitive old-object preservation and new-fragment/source metadata checks. Native originals are not present and not re-read. Credential scanning is limited to high-confidence patterns in new exports; it is not a universal secrecy proof or whole-provider capture claim.
